capture_contract.preferred_engine: Unity URP, imported production prefab, Director resident editor
capture_contract.fallback_engine: Blender source or FBX clearly labelled; never substitutes for Unity proof
capture_contract.camera: front is actor +Z in Unity; source -Y in Blender
capture_contract.lighting: fixed key in front of face, soft fill, constant exposure; no silhouette-only backlighting
capture_contract.framing: Do not reframe separately per sample; union of clip mesh bounds prevents clipping limbs/wings
capture_contract.sampling: Use evaluated Animator/Playable; verify actual bone/mesh change before rendering sequence
capture_contract.source_identity: Persist source SHA, FBX SHA, imported prefab GUID, Unity version and renderer in each receipt
capture_contract.review_status: Generated and reviewed are independent. Missing evidence stays pending, never marked approved.
capture_contract.bite_contact: Source pose shows animation only; contact evidence needs W1/W2 attachment on a real skin surface
capture_contract.human_fp: Visibility mode, not a cosmetic variant; first-person camera evidence belongs to integration capture
